test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

I called your name wrong _________ mistake.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"by mistake"** is a common idiom used to indicate that something was done unintentionally.
 
• The use of **"by"** in this context is correct and idiomatic.
 
• The other options (on, with, at) do not fit well in this context and would render the sentence incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I called your name wrong **by mistake**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On mistake** – This is not a common or correct phrase in English.
 
• **With mistake** – This phrase is not idiomatic and is rarely, if ever, used.
 
• **At mistake** – This phrase is incorrect in this context as it does not convey the intended meaning.
